question: Which of five fixed 16-base ASO binding positions per catalogued EMC junction has the least normal-parent sequence matching under a declared comparison?
normal_corpus: Frozen six-parent 77-record/71-unique-sequence corpus, augmented by archived canonical PGR cDNA and all PGR-labelled accession versions returned by a captured hg38 UCSC ncbiRefSeqCurated gene-interval query. Apply the same augmented corpus to all 220 designs. Preserve six-parent comparisons separately.
comparison: Primary: minimize the longest consecutive exact match spanning all six proposed DNA-gap positions across every complete 16-base window in the corpus. A zero means no complete exact six-base gap match, not no complementarity.
Secondary, applied only to primary ties: maximize the minimum Hamming distance across EVERY complete normal 16-base window, not just primary-metric winning windows.
Keep every final tie. Also report primary-only co-winners and Pareto alternatives with competing metric values. No weighted score, biological threshold or arbitrary sole representative.
orientation: Target and normal RNA sequences are forward 5-to-3 in DNA alphabet. ASO is the reverse complement of the target. Gap is target positions 6 through 11 inclusive.
ambiguity: Require unambiguous A/C/G/T reference bases for whole-window ranking. If ambiguous reference symbols occur, stop and append a handling amendment before execution rather than silently treating them as mismatches.
evidence: Carry forward directly deposited sequence matches, coordinate-based reference reconstruction and engineered-construct reconstruction separately. Remaining junctions are hypothetical exact reference joins even where fusion/exon names were published. Keep the annotation-error control separate from target counts. No independent-patient counts.
verification: Verify all target windows against donor/acceptor sequence and antisense orientation
Reproduce the 40 previously accepted six-parent expanded comparisons
Compare two independently implemented gap-run searches
Validate Hamming encoding against character-wise Hamming including controlled boundary cases
Retain all winning normal-transcript locations and accession aliases
Independent read-only review of changed science
claim_boundary: Best by this declared parent-sequence comparison among five positions. Not an optimal ASO over all lengths, chemistry, transcriptome, pre-mRNA, expression, accessibility or biological activity. No cleavage/selectivity/safety claim. Previous genome/transcriptome screens are unchanged and not ranking gates.
source_of_rule: Bounded independent scientific advisor; specified before complete catalogue execution. No cutoff optimization.
paired_comparisons: Six canonical parent transcripts and frozen six-gene expanded corpus are retained for continuity checks. Seven canonical parent transcripts provide equal gene coverage for the isoform-expansion comparison. Compare primary co-winner sets between seven canonical and seven expanded corpora.
